name: Felix Whindlebolt
summary: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Felix Whindlebolt seeks shelter after fleeing Gnomeregan. He lost his belongings in the rush, and Frostmane trolls carried them away.

sections.title: A Displaced Traveler
sections.body: Felix Whindlebolt fled Gnomeregan when radiation flooded the city. In his haste, he lost his personal belongings and tools. Frostmane ice trolls carried his chest, box and bucket of bolts to their camps southwest of Anvilmar. Now stranded without his gear, Felix relies on travelers to retrieve it.

faq.answer: Felix Whindlebolt is a gnome refugee sheltered at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He lost his belongings while fleeing Gnomeregan, and Frostmane trolls took them.

faq.q: Where was Felix trying to go?
aliases: why is felix in coldridge valley
faq.answer: Felix fled the radiation that overran Gnomeregan after the gnomes' attempt to drive out the troggs went horribly wrong. He reached Anvilmar, a dwarven outpost in Coldridge Valley, but finds it poorly suited to a gnome.
In his haste to escape Gnomeregan, Felix lost his chest, box and bucket of bolts. Frostmane ice trolls carried them to their camps southwest of Anvilmar, leaving him without supplies.

faq.q: What does Felix sell to adventurers?
faq.answer: Felix sells nothing. He lost all his belongings while fleeing Gnomeregan, and at Anvilmar he can only thank anyone who recovers his chest, box and bucket of bolts.

angles.text: As a gnome, Felix reflects the plight of your kin, driven into the cold of Dun Morogh after Gnomeregan's fall.
As a dwarf, you can see how Frostmane trolls strike at gnome refugees near Anvilmar, growing bolder across Coldridge Valley.
